sonnet.problem: The question says 'The four men can't get to Jesus through the crowd.' That gives away the answer to card 4, which asks whether the men make it through the crowd. Both cards also ask about the same fact from Mark 2:4.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later. Once a choice has been answered, the cards after it can build on that answer. An easy follow-up asks something new. It never re-asks the same fact. Two lines that make the same point get one question.
